name: After recital A
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text: Aa. whereas colonialism in the Great Lake region by European countries such as Belgium, France, the United Kingdom and Germany relied on ‘divide and rule’ policies; whereas the Belgian Government, for example, created institutionalised divisions between the Hutu and the Tutsi by fabricating racial and ethnic cleavages; whereas these divisions ultimately led to the genocide of the Tutsi in 1994;
